name: huddle
description: Real-time communication platform: video meetings, screen sharing, whiteboard, file sharing (MERN + WebRTC + Socket.io)

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client
